name: ringback
description: Phones you when Claude Code is blocked waiting for your input

delay_seconds.title: Delay before calling (seconds)
delay_seconds.description: How long a prompt must sit unanswered before you get a call

cooldown_minutes.title: Cooldown between calls (minutes)
cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum gap between calls for the same session

max_calls_per_day.title: Max calls per day (all sessions)
max_calls_per_day.description: Hard cap on total calls placed across all sessions in a rolling 24 hours

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours (local time)
quiet_hours.description: No calls during this window, e.g. 23:00-07:00. Leave empty to disable.

twilio_from_number.title: Twilio caller number
twilio_from_number.description: Your Twilio phone number in E.164 format. Required if provider=twilio

webhook_url.title: Webhook URL
webhook_url.description: Required if provider=webhook. Receives a JSON POST with call details.
